Indications
  • constant Green = fleet
  • blinking green = waiting for dispatch
  • constant Red = Error
  • blinking red = emergency button is pressed
  • running red = Low battery
  • yellow = obstacle detected
  • no indication = mode is off
Notes: If in Tug, only one indicator is on then it means it has  delfino issue, we need to do Remote wheel calibration if not connecting or pinging then we need a to check the bot physically

Command:
ping 192.168.1.100 (xt,tug,xt-lite)
ping 192.168.1.1xx (pm,monofork)(xx is the last 2 digit of lidar serial no.)
Instruction: If this is the case than it mean hub motor issue or lidar issue.Check the plots,ping the lidar,check lidar firmware version, it should be greater than 2.5.2 (2.5.3 current latest version)
Notes:
Indications :
- PS4 not turning on means battery died
- Full Charge will show Constant yellow light
- Charging will show Blinking Yellow light
